exposure: ultrasound measurement of lower uterine segment thickness
multifaceted intervention including ultrasound estimation of uterine rupture risk
outcome: operative findings observed during cesarean delivery
cohort: The study participants are women with a history of cesarean delivery.
finding: While ultrasound measurements of lower uterine segment thickness are strongly correlated with operative findings of uterine defects, using this measurement alone to propose a mode of delivery did not significantly reduce maternal-fetal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: The PRISMA trial, which included LUS measurement as part of a multifaceted intervention, significantly reduced major perinatal and maternal morbidity without increasing cesarean delivery rates, whereas the LUSTrial found no significant impact on maternal-fetal morbidity by basing mode of delivery recommendations on LUS thickness.
